description: Arky Test Vectors Release - core-loop L2 coverage plus executable non-core suites (Discovery D2/D3, Attestations AT2/AT3, Policy Packs, Registries, Errors)

changes.description: Non-core suite expansion: check-dispatched executable vectors, negative-tested
changes: Discovery D2 (8 new): descriptor JWS/cid verify (+tampered), spec-level compatibility, security.auth allowlist, policy-binding precedence
Discovery D3 (4): capability accuracy vs live capabilities, health/readiness endpoints
Attestations AT2 (8): AttestationResult cid+JWS verify (+tampered), registry-driven freshness, content binding (nonce==cid), key binding (did:key verifies TIM sig)
Attestations AT3 (4): claims-vs-policy evaluation, registered-type enforcement
New policy-packs suite (3): pack signature validity, most-restrictive-wins merge, forbidden-override rejection
New registries suite (3): snapshot signature verify (+tampered), URN/CAIP-2 grammar
New errors suite (4): envelope structure, retry-hint rules, code-namespace taxonomy
Verifier: check-dispatched executor runs positive AND negative vectors; every new check corrupt-tested

changes.description: Level 2/3 expansion: executable algorithmic vectors + end-to-end reference path
changes: Added Notary N2 vectors (4): Merkle root, odd-count padding, inclusion proof, negative bad-proof
Added Notary N3 vectors (3): finality depth max(), policy-floor violation, reorg remediation
Added Settler S2 vectors (2): idempotency key derivation, STOP_ON_FAILURE cascade
Added Settler S3 vectors (2): compensation verb map, XR state transitions
Made Canonicalization C1 vectors executable (recompute JCS bytes vs expect)
Added end-to-end reference path (TIM->anchor->kernel->decision->XR, cryptographically linked)
Verifier now executes algorithmic vectors and walks chain linkage; emits results.json

changes.description: Phase 1 vector implementation - Level 1 coverage across all core specs
changes: Added TIM T1 vectors (7 vectors): validation, signatures, CID, timestamps
Added Canonicalization C1 vectors (6 vectors): JCS key ordering, numbers, escaping
Added Kernel K1 vectors (10 vectors): parsing, threshold, range, identity rules
Added Notary N1 vectors (8 vectors): intake, witness, skew, rate limiting
Added Settlers S1 vectors (10 vectors): pay, refund, signal, control, slash verbs
Added Discovery D1 vectors (6 vectors): revocations, index, JWKS, services
Fixed corrupted attestation vectors
Created shared fixtures: keys, TIMs, rails, accounts
Restructured manifest format for consistency
breaking_changes: Discovery vectors renamed from d1-revocations-001 to d1-001 format
Attestation vectors reformatted with proper JSON structure

status.core_readiness_note: The five core-loop suites (TIM, Canonicalization, Kernel, Notary, Settlers) have L2 conformance coverage and pass on two independent implementations (TS @arky/core and Rust arky-core), cross-checked byte-identically. Their specs are at lifecycle state 'implementing' (>=2 implementations) pending formal TC ratification to 'stable'. Non-core suites remain in development.
completed: TIM T2 vectors (freshness/expiry, witness co-signing, witness mismatch)
Kernel K2 vectors (negative literals, type-mismatch INDETERMINATE, timezone-offset window)
